Fields.Name: Standard
Documentation: Encodes with the alphabet defined in RFC 4648 (with potential padding bytes)

Fields.Name: StandardUrlSafe
Documentation: Encodes with the 'URL and Filename Safe' alphabet from RFC 4648 (with potential padding bytes)

Fields.Name: Character
Documentation: Locate extended grapheme cluster boundaries, which are treated as user-perceived character units.

Fields.Name: Word
Documentation: Locate word boundaries for selection, search, and whole-word operations, including locale dictionary support where available.

Fields.Name: Sentence
Documentation: Locate sentence boundaries while handling cases such as periods in numbers or abbreviations and trailing punctuation.

Fields.Name: Line
Documentation: Locate positions where text can wrap, using Unicode line-breaking rules that handle punctuation and hyphenated words.

Fields.Name: Primary
Documentation: Compare base-character differences and ignore accents, case, and later collation levels.

Fields.Name: Secondary
Documentation: Compare accent or diacritic differences after base characters match, while ignoring tertiary differences such as case.

Fields.Name: Tertiary
Documentation: Compare case, letter variants, and similar tertiary differences after primary and secondary differences match.

Fields.Name: Quaternary
Documentation: Distinguish punctuation, whitespace, symbols, or Japanese Hiragana/Katakana differences after the first three levels match.

Fields.Name: Identical
Documentation: Use NFD Unicode code point order as a final tie-breaker after all other collation levels match.

Fields.Name: Symbol
Documentation: A symbolic name for a currency, such as '$' for USD.

Fields.Name: NarrowSymbol
Documentation: The shortest narrow currency symbol, such as '$' instead of 'US$' for USD in en-CA.

Fields.Name: Long
Documentation: The long name for a currency, such as 'US Dollar' for USD.

Fields.Name: FormalSymbol
Documentation: The formal currency symbol is similar to the regular currency symbol, but it always takes the form used in formal settings such as banking; for example, 'NT$' instead of '$' for TWD in zh-TW.

Fields.Name: VariantSymbol
Documentation: The variant symbol for a currency is an alternative symbol that is not necessarily as widely used as the regular symbol.

Fields.Name: Stealable
Documentation: Shows the dispel type only for stealable auras.

Fields.Name: NotStealable
Documentation: Shows the dispel type only for non-stealable auras.

Fields.Name: Border
Documentation: Uses a built-in border based on the aura's dispel type.

Fields.Name: BorderWithIcon
Documentation: Uses a built-in border with a corner icon based on the aura's dispel type.

Fields.Name: Icon
Documentation: Uses a built-in icon based on the aura's dispel type.

Fields.Name: PreserveAsset
Documentation: Preserves the texture's existing asset.

Fields.Name: CustomAsset
Documentation: Uses a custom texture asset selected from the configured dispel type asset map.

Fields.Name: Assignment
Documentation: Applies a newly assigned aura, resetting presentation state rather than transitioning from the previous aura.

Fields.Name: Update
Documentation: Refreshes the current aura assignment, allowing presentation state to retain continuity.

Fields.Name: None
Documentation: Do not include this date or time portion in the formatter.

Fields.Name: Short
Documentation: Use the shortest locale format, generally numeric, such as 12/13/52 or 3:30pm.

Fields.Name: Medium
Documentation: Use a longer locale format than Short, such as abbreviated month names for dates.

Fields.Name: Long
Documentation: Use a longer locale format with fuller names or time fields than Medium.

Fields.Name: Full
Documentation: Use the most completely specified locale format, such as weekday, era, or time zone when applicable.

Fields.Name: RealTime
Documentation: Use real time for duration calculations. Durations will speed up or slow down based on the applied mod time.

Fields.Name: BaseTime
Documentation: Use base time for duration calculations. Durations will be unaffected the applied mod time.

Fields.Name: TextWarning
Documentation: Color to be used when an encounter event shown as a text warning alert.

Fields.Name: TimelineEvent
Documentation: Color to be used when an encounter event is placed on the timeline.

Fields.Name: TimelineEventHighlight
Documentation: Color to be used when an encounter event reaches its 'highlight' duration on the timeline (typically, ~5s before the cast is due).

Fields.Name: OnTextWarningShown
Documentation: Trigger to be activated when an text warning is initially shown for an encounter event.

Fields.Name: OnTimelineEventFinished
Documentation: Trigger to be activated when an encounter event on the timeline transitions to a finished (ie. casted, or resolved) state.

Fields.Name: OnTimelineEventHighlight
Documentation: Trigger to be activated when an encounter event reaches its 'highlight' duration on the timeline (typically, ~5s before the cast is due).

Fields.Name: Descending
Documentation: Events are sorted in descending order (longest time remaining to shortest).

Fields.Name: Ascending
Documentation: Events are sorted in ascending order (shortest time remaining to longest).

contract.Name: EncounterTimelineEventSource
Documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline event sources.

Fields.Name: Encounter
Documentation: Source used for events added by an instance encounter.

Fields.Name: Script
Documentation: Source used for events added by Lua scripting APIs. This is used to apply API restrictions; the Pause/Cancel/ResumeScriptEvent functions only work on Script events.

Fields.Name: EditMode
Documentation: Source used for events added by the AddEditModeEvents script API.

contract.Name: EncounterTimelineEventState
Documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline event states.

contract.Name: EncounterTimelineTrack
Documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline tracks., Tracks are not permitted to overlap (but may have a zero duration span), and are contiguously ordered from shortest maximum duration to longest.

Fields.Name: Short
Documentation: This track always has a zero minimum duration.

Fields.Name: Indeterminate
Documentation: This track is used as a placeholder for events whose position is not calculated and shouldn't appear on the timeline.

contract.Name: EncounterTimelineTrackType
Documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline track types. Track types infer behavioral aspects of the track, for example whether or not we associate sort orders to events in the track.

contract.Name: EncounterTimelineViewType
Documentation: Enumeration of view types for the timeline., View types control layout parameters for the timeline such as maximum track durations and event counts, and optimize event processing for expected display behaviors.

Fields.Name: None
Documentation: Configures the view for an empty timeline display. This mode is recommended for user addons that take full control of the timeline display.

Fields.Name: Timeline
Documentation: Configures the view for a linear timeline display.

Fields.Name: Bars
Documentation: Configures the view for a sorted timer bar display.

Fields.Name: FontSize
Documentation: Scale animations apply to the height of the font. This will cause small jumps between different font heights as the animation progresses, and may adjust the layout of text if used on a fixed-size font string.

Fields.Name: Vertex
Documentation: Scale animations apply to the vertices of the font. Scaling is smoother, but if used on non-slug fonts may cause significant pixelation of the font text, Layout of the text is not adjusted as the animation progresses, and the direction of scaling respects horizontal and vertical justification settings (eg. text at the bottom-right scaling up grows toward the top-left).

Fields.Name: SetToDefaults
Documentation: Restricts resetting this object to a default state. Implied automatically when any other forbidden aspect is set.

Fields.Name: ScriptBindings
Documentation: Restricts querying, replacement, or hooks of scripts on this object.

Fields.Name: UntrustedScriptExecution
Documentation: Restricts execution of all scripts for this object. Propagates to any children of this object.

Fields.Name: UntrustedLayoutScriptExecution
Documentation: Restricts execution of layout scripts (eg. OnSizeChanged) for this object. Propagates to any children of this object, and anything anchored to to this object.

Fields.Name: EventRegistrations
Documentation: Restricts querying or modifying registered script events for this object.

Fields.Name: AlwaysPropagateInput
Documentation: Forces propagation of mouse and keypress input for this object. Propagates to any children.

Fields.Name: ScriptedInput
Documentation: Restricts APIs that trigger synthetic input interactions on objects from Lua scripts.

Fields.Name: QueryFocus
Documentation: Restricts APIs that query input focus state.

Fields.Name: ChangeAnimationTarget
Documentation: Restricts APIs that can change the target object of an animation.

Fields.Name: RemoveSecretAspects
Documentation: Restricts APIs that clear secret aspects from objects.

Fields.Name: ChangeParent
Documentation: Restricts APIs that change the parent of an object.

Fields.Name: SetTexture
Documentation: Restricts APIs that set the texture on a texture object.

Fields.Name: QueryRotation
Documentation: Restricts APIs that query texture rotation.

Fields.Name: QueryAnimationProgress
Documentation: Restricts APIs that query the progress or state of animations.

Fields.Name: AddAnimations
Documentation: Restricts APIs that add animations to animation groups.

Fields.Name: None
Documentation: Not in a house or plot, or at one without even sufficient visiting permissions

Fields.Name: Owner
Documentation: Owner of the current house or plot

Fields.Name: Visitor
Documentation: A visitor of the current house or plot

contract.Name: HousingFixtureDecorAction

Fields.Name: Detach
Documentation: Detach any currently-attached decor, and leave it floating in its current position; It will NOT be re-attached to the new Exterior Fixtures

Fields.Name: Canonicalize
Documentation: Canonicalizes the locale identifier into ICU's canonical locale ID form.

Fields.Name: AddLikelySubtags
Documentation: Adds likely script and region subtags according to CLDR likely-subtags data.

Fields.Name: RemoveLikelySubtags
Documentation: Minimizes script and region subtags according to CLDR likely-subtags data.

Fields.Name: Language
Documentation: Gets the language code from the locale identifier.

Fields.Name: Script
Documentation: Gets the script code from the locale identifier.

Fields.Name: Region
Documentation: Gets the region code from the locale identifier.

Fields.Name: Variant
Documentation: Gets the variant code from the locale identifier.

Fields.Name: ParentLocale
Documentation: Gets the parent locale identifier.

Fields.Name: Linear
Documentation: Linearly interpolates between points.

Fields.Name: Step
Documentation: Performs no interpolation between points, instead snapping to values exactly.

Fields.Name: Cosine
Documentation: Interpolates between points with cosine smoothing applied.

Fields.Name: Cubic
Documentation: Interpolates between points with cubic smoothing applied. Requires a minimum of four points be defined; less than this will fall back to Cosine interpolation.

Fields.Name: Nfc
Documentation: Canonical decomposition followed by canonical composition.

Fields.Name: Nfd
Documentation: Canonical decomposition.

Fields.Name: Nfkc
Documentation: Compatibility decomposition followed by canonical composition.

Fields.Name: Nfkd
Documentation: Compatibility decomposition.

Fields.Name: Decimal
Documentation: Use normal decimal number format for the locale.

Fields.Name: Integer
Documentation: Use decimal formatting with zero minimum and maximum fraction digits in this wrapper.

Fields.Name: Percent
Documentation: Use percent number format for the locale.

Fields.Name: Currency
Documentation: Use generic currency format with a currency symbol and non-accounting minus-sign negatives.

Fields.Name: Disabled
Documentation: Disable OnUpdate execution.

Fields.Name: RunWhenVisible
Documentation: Run OnUpdate only while object is visible.

Fields.Name: RunWhenVisibleOnce
Documentation: Run OnUpdate once while object is visible; resets to Disabled before running.

Fields.Name: RunOnce
Documentation: Run OnUpdate once regardless of visibility; resets to Disabled before running.

Fields.Name: RunAlways
Documentation: Run OnUpdate regardless of visibility.

Fields.Name: Cardinal
Documentation: Use plural rules for counted quantities, such as 1 file vs. 2 files.

Fields.Name: Ordinal
Documentation: Use plural rules for ordered values, such as 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th.

Fields.Name: DenyTaintedAccessWhenAurasAreSecret
Documentation: Denies access to this script object from tainted execution while aura information is secret.

Fields.Name: Hierarchy
Documentation: Propagation through script object hierarchy relationships, such as parent-child ownership.

Fields.Name: Layout
Documentation: Propagation through layout dependency relationships, such as frames anchored relative to one another.

Fields.Name: Preserve
Documentation: Do not strip any whitespace from interval unit strings.

Fields.Name: Strip
Documentation: Strip whitespace from interval unit strings. Some locales override this setting (eg. deDE, ruRU).

Fields.Name: StripIgnoreLocale
Documentation: Always strip whitespace from interval unit strings even if the client locale should normally preserve whitespace.

Fields.Name: RoundUp
Documentation: Round fractional seconds up to the next whole second when not displaying milliseconds.

Fields.Name: Truncate
Documentation: Truncate fractional seconds to the current whole second when not displaying milliseconds.

Fields.Name: NeverSecret
Documentation: Will never yield secret values when queried.

Fields.Name: AlwaysSecret
Documentation: Will always yield secret values when queried.

Fields.Name: ContextuallySecret
Documentation: May yield secret values when queried depending upon factors such as addon restriction states, unit disposition, etc.

Fields.Name: Standard
Documentation: Fills the bar regularly, either in a left-to-right or top-to-bottom direction as values increase.

Fields.Name: StandardNoRangeFill
Documentation: Similar to standard, except if the range between the min and max values is zero instead render as-if the bar were 100% full. If the min and max values are both zero, will render as 0% full.

Fields.Name: Center
Documentation: Fills the bar in an outward growing manner from the center.

Fields.Name: Reverse
Documentation: Inverse of Standard, filling right-to-left or bottom-to-top as values increase.

Fields.Name: Immediate
Documentation: Immediately snap to the target value with no interpolation.

Fields.Name: ExponentialEaseOut
Documentation: Interpolate the bar toward the target value with exponential ease-out style decay.

Fields.Name: Linear
Documentation: Render the status bar using the existing linear horizontal or vertical fill behavior.

Fields.Name: Radial
Documentation: Render the status bar by driving the managed texture's radial progress fill percent instead of resizing the texture anchors.

Fields.Name: ElapsedTime
Documentation: Calculate status timer bar values using the elapsed time of a duration.

Fields.Name: RemainingTime
Documentation: Calculate status timer bar values using the remaining time of a duration.

Fields.Name: Unsorted
Documentation: Applies no sorting to auras.

Fields.Name: Default
Documentation: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by the player, else whether or not the player can apply the aura, and finally by aura instance ID.

Fields.Name: BigDefensive
Documentation: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by another player, else by expiration time (longest to shortest), and finally by aura instance ID.

Fields.Name: Expiration
Documentation: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by the player, else whether or not the player can apply the aura, then by expiration time (soonest to longest, followed by permanent auras), and finally by aura instance ID.

Fields.Name: ExpirationOnly
Documentation: Sorts auras according only to expiration time.

Fields.Name: Name
Documentation: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by the player, else whether or not the player can apply the aura, then by spell name, and finally by aura instance ID.

Fields.Name: NameOnly
Documentation: Sorts auras according only their spell name.

Fields.Name: MissingHealth
Documentation: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of missing health with incoming heals subtracted.

Fields.Name: MissingHealthWithoutIncomingHeals
Documentation: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of missing health. Incoming heals do not decrease missing health.

Fields.Name: MaximumHealth
Documentation: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of maximum health.

Fields.Name: CurrentHealth
Documentation: Clamp heal absorb values to the amount of current health.

Fields.Name: MaximumHealth
Documentation: Clamp heal absorb values to the amount of maximum health.

Fields.Name: ReducedByIncomingHeals
Documentation: Reduce heal absorb values by incoming heals, and vice versa, clamping to zero where necessary.

Fields.Name: Total
Documentation: Use heal absorb and incoming heal values as-is without any reductions.

Fields.Name: MissingHealth
Documentation: Clamp incoming heal values to the amount of missing health with overflow applied.

Fields.Name: MaximumHealth
Documentation: Clamp incoming heal values to the amount of maximum health.

Fields.Name: Default
Documentation: Use maximum unit health as-is without adjustments.

Fields.Name: WithAbsorbs
Documentation: Use maximum unit health with total damage absorb shields added.

Documentation: Requires that all mouse foci are not forbidden, hidden from the global environment, fully locked down, script inaccessible, or protected frames (while in combat)

Documentation: Requires that this object permit assignment of scripts of this type. May fail for reasons such as the script type not being supported, or secret aspects blocking assignments.

contract.Name: RequiresCanChangeHitTestPoints
Documentation: Guarded APIs require that the nameplate frame must allow changes to its hit test points.

contract.Name: RequiresComparableUnitTokens
Documentation: Guarded APIs only accept unit token pairs that can be compared with one another. For example, comparisons where either unit is 'player' or 'target' are permitted, but comparisons between 'nameplate3' and 'boss1' are not.

contract.Name: RequiresDeclassifiedUnitIdentity
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events require that callers have access to the identity of a supplied unit token.

contract.Name: RequiresFontStringTextAccess
Documentation: Guarded APIs reject access for tainted callers if the object has the secret Text aspect assigned.

contract.Name: RequiresNonSecretAura
Documentation: Guarded APIs require that that the requested aura be non-secret at the time of the API call. This does not raise a blocked action error - instead, protected APIs will return no values.

contract.Name: RequiresSupportedScript
Documentation: Requires a valid script type supported by this object. If not supported, functions will return no values.

contract.Name: RequiresTimedSignalMapAccess
Documentation: Guarded APIs on a timed signal map raise an error when the map holds secret values and is accessed from a tainted execution context.

contract.Name: RequiresUnitAuraAccess
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events require that callers have access to unit aura data.

contract.Name: RequiresUnitIdentityAccess
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events require that callers have access to unit identity values. This does not raise a blocked action error - instead, protected APIs will return no values.

contract.Name: RestrictedForMacroChatMessages
Documentation: Restricts sending chat messages on chat types that can be observed by external players. Only applies during instance encounters for messages initiated from macros.

contract.Name: TransliteratorAllowed
Documentation: Prevents Remove and Null transliterators when used with secret text arguments.

contract.Name: SecretInActivePvPMatch
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when PvP match addon restrictions are in effect.

contract.Name: SecretInChatMessagingLockdown
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect, and when the player is on a communication-restricted map such as a dungeon or raid.

contract.Name: SecretOnRestrictedMaps
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the player is on an addon-restricted map such as a dungeon or raid.

contract.Name: SecretWhenAnchoringSecret
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when an object has secret anchoring information.

contract.Name: SecretWhenAurasRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect.

contract.Name: SecretWhenCooldownsRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect. Individual spells may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority over restrictions.

contract.Name: SecretWhenInCombat
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat addon restrictions are in effect.

contract.Name: SecretWhenLossOfControlInfoRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values if the subject unit is not the active player, unless they are an active spectator or commentator of a PvP match.

contract.Name: SecretWhenLuaTableHasSecretKeys
Documentation: Guarded APIs produce secret values if the subject Lua table contains any secret keys.

contract.Name: SecretWhenTotemSlotSecret
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect. Individual totem spell auras may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority over restrictions.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitAuraRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect. Individual spells may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority over restrictions.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitComparisonRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based upon supplied unit tokens. Comparisons involving compound unit tokens (eg. 'boss1target') are always secret. This restriction only applies when the player is on an addon-restricted map.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitHealthMaxRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the unit isn't player-controlled.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitIdentityRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the unit isn't player-controlled or in the party/raid. For compound tokens (eg. 'boss1target'), results are secret if any unit in the chain fails this.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitNameIdentityRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values under regular unit identity secrecy rules, except in PvP when the queried unit is a player.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitPossessionRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based on aura secrecy, except for unit tokens under the player's direct control.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitPowerMaxRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the unit isn't player-controlled. Individual power types may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitPowerRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values for power types not explicitly flagged as being never secret, unless the subject unit does not have a power of this type.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitSpellCastRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values if the unit being queried for cast information is not the player or their pet. Individual spells may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitStatsRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when access to unit stats would generally produce secret values.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitThreatStateRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based upon supplied unit tokens. Queries where only one unit token is specified, or where one unit token is the player, their pet, or an ally while the other is a nameplate, boss, target, etc., are generally not secret.

contract.Name: SecretWhenUnitThreatValuesRestricted
Documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based upon supplied unit tokens. Queries where only one unit token is specified, or where one unit token is the player, their pet, or an ally while the other is a non-boss or nameplate target, are generally not secret.
